{{cv|DF2012|Grazer}}
{{vercat|DF2012|Grazer|Creatures by attribute}}
Tame grazing animals (those with the GRAZER [[Creature token#G|token]]) require a constant source of [[grass]] or [[cave moss]] to survive. [[Pasture]]s are currently the easiest such source, however care must be taken to ensure that the pasture is large enough to provide food for all the assigned animals (and any auto-assigned babies).
